info.title: Jef Bot API
info.summary: AI chat moderation for Discord servers, game chat and any app.
info.description: The /v1 API of Jef Bot. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`: account keys (jef_acct_…) can do everything on the account; app keys (jef_app_…) can only moderate and read one app (plus warn/pardon its users). Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`. Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC. Guides: /docs/agents.html, /docs/quickstart-game.html. Full text for LLMs: /llms-full.txt.

accountKey.description: Account key: full access to the account.

appKey.description: App key: moderation and reads for one app.

sessionCookie.name: jef_session
sessionCookie.description: Dashboard session after Google sign-in. Changes must be same-origin JSON.

code.description: Machine-readable code, e.g. invalid_request, unauthorized, invalid_api_key, forbidden, plan_limit, limit, not_found, guild_taken, rate_limited, invalid_json, too_large, bad_origin, json_required, no_customer, billing_unavailable, billing_error, internal.

subscriptionStatus.description: Stripe's subscription status (active, trialing, past_due, canceled, unpaid, …) or null.

aiChecksPerMonth.description: Messages that may reach the AI per calendar month (UTC), per account; at most a tenth (rounded up) per UTC day. null = unlimited.

requestsPerSecond.description: POST /v1/moderate requests per second, per app (bursts up to twice this).

purchasable.description: Whether this server can sell the plan (Free is always true).

messages.description: Messages moderated this month, all apps.

aiChecks.description: AI checks used this month, all apps.

appId.description: The app, for app keys; null for account keys.

prefix.description: First characters of the secret, e.g. jef_app_3kq9.

lastUsedAt.description: Updated at most once a minute.

secret.description: The full key (jef_acct_… or jef_app_…). Shown only this once.

AppSettings.description: Discord apps only. Unset settings are absent.

discordGuildId.description: The linked Discord server, for Discord apps.

webhookSecret.description: whsec_… signing secret. Omitted when read with an app key.

inPlan.description: Within the plan's app count (apps counted oldest first). false after a downgrade: not moderated until apps are deleted or the plan is upgraded.

rules.description: All rules; only the oldest up to the plan's customRules are applied.

inviteUrl.description: "Add to server" link; null if the server has no Discord bot configured.

autoLink.description: Adding the bot with inviteUrl links the server automatically, if the person is signed in to the dashboard as the app's owner when Discord redirects back; otherwise use linkCommand.

webhookUrl.description: Public https URL. Paid plans only.

createKey.description: API apps: also create an app key. Ignored for Discord apps.

appKey.description: API apps, unless createKey is false.

webhookUrl.description: Paid plans. null or "" removes it.

settings.description: Discord apps only. Merged into current settings; null clears one.

durationMs.description: Mute length; null for none, delete and ban (permanent).

message.description: Text to show the user; null for none and delete.

level.description: Ladder step (5 = ban). Present on mute and ban.

appId.description: Required with an account key or session; optional with an app key (must match).

room.description: Channel, lobby or match. The last 5 messages per room are used as context when context is not sent.

aiSkipped.description: Present only when the AI was skipped because the account's AI checks for the month, or for the UTC day (a tenth of the monthly allowance, rounded up), are used up.

by.description: "auto" or who issued a manual warning.
Who issued it; defaults to the signed-in email or the key name.

count.description: How many of the newest active strikes to remove; all when omitted.

nextBefore.description: Pass as ?before= for the next (older) page.

url.description: A Stripe page for a person to open.

kind.description: portal when the account already has a subscription.

data.description: moderation.action: ModerationResult plus userId, username, room, text. moderation.manual: userId, username, reason, severity, action, strikes, by. moderation.pardon: userId, username, removed, strikes, by.

E400.description: invalid_request, invalid_json (or no_customer for the billing portal)

E403.description: forbidden (app key where an account is needed), plan_limit (over a plan limit, an app with inPlan false, or an account key past the plan's key count), limit, or bad_origin
